(Alzahrani, 2020) recommends that for wider adoption within the educational 
sector the technology needs to become more user-friendly and cost-effective. 
Additionally, teachers will need training on how to use and best utilise the 
technology within their classrooms. Once these hurdles have been overcome, AR 
offers to significantly enhance the learning experience. 
In summary the real-world implementation of AR technologies is highly 
dependent on its need. AR offers a platform to explore concepts that are not 
possible within classrooms. Despite this, its high cost and the challenge of 
integration into the classroom, leaves it largely redundant. 
2.4.3 AI-Powered Platforms 
AI has become somewhat of a buzz word in recent times with the huge strides in 
its development, by companies such as Open-AI and Google. With the phrase 
“AI” in search related interests increasing by almost tenfold in the past year 
alone (Google Trends, 2024). 
A more novel study by (Lathaharan, et al., 2023) investigates the utilisation of 
CNNs and NLPs within eLearning, showing the true breadth of AI applications 
within eLearning. Two of the more relevant applications include emotion 
recognition and drowsiness detection, which would enable the system to react 
according to the user’s current state.
